Condition: The record ID and private image path are unique and the declared source/type are present.
Why this rule?: Prevents ambiguous lineage or counting the same index row twice.

Condition: The original SHA-256 matches, and the image verifies and decodes as RGB JPEG.
Why this rule?: Detects missing, corrupt, substituted or incorrectly encoded images.

Condition: Car class 0 boxes match the count and have finite coordinates within the image.
Why this rule?: Detects malformed labels. Reviewed negatives can legitimately have zero boxes.

Condition: For replay, all 24 distinct bay IDs have a recognised state and a reason.
Why this rule?: Prevents missing or invented statuses and preserves the reason for uncertainty.

Condition: For replay, frame time agrees with each bay state and track within 0.1 ms.
Why this rule?: Prevents joining the wrong moment of a clip with a bay status or vehicle position.

Condition: For replay, track IDs in each frame are distinct and coordinates are finite.
Why this rule?: Detects records that cannot be replayed or traced to a unique track.

Condition: Frames with invalid alignment report all 24 bays as unknown.
Why this rule?: Detects cases where unusable alignment could be presented as a known bay state.
